summary: Frontend-only testing of CutPreview Expo app via web preview. Priorities 1, 2, 3, 5 PASS. Priority 4 (slider smoothness) could not be reliably verified via Playwright on web preview due to a known React Native Web PanResponder/mouse quirk — the slider works and renders fine, but mouse drag via Playwright failed to update the value past the min, and a single mouse.click on the slider body unexpectedly cleared the region selection on web. On a device/Expo Go this is expected to behave correctly (confirmed by code review of Slider.tsx: continuous emit with throttle, quantize, drag state). App boots WITHOUT a red screen or 'undefined is not a function' crash — the expo-navigation-bar removal fix is verified. Full navigation flow (index -> متابعة -> library -> تدرج متوسط -> المحرر) works, all 4 region chips (top, fringe, sides, back) correctly update editor-sheet-title and show slider-length-<region>. save-btn, undo-btn, redo-btn, editor-apply, and panel-expand-toggle are all present and visible with no overlap; the viewer stays visible when toggling the panel. 2D SVG fallback appears as expected on web. Minor non-blocking console warnings observed: deprecated `shadow*` style props and `props.pointerEvents` deprecation.

integration_issues.issue: Dragging the length slider via Playwright mouse events does not update the displayed value past the min (stays at '4.0 سم'). A direct page.mouse.click on the slider track also clears the current region selection on web (region becomes null and hint text reappears). This appears to be a React Native Web PanResponder / mouse-event mapping issue — locationX during mouse move is not relative to the slider on web. Priority 4 (slider smoothness) therefore cannot be verified on web preview and must be validated on a real device / Expo Go.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a <View pointerEvents="box-none"> or pointerEvents="none" usage. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/editor.tsx around the fabColumn View (uses pointerEvents="box-none") and /app/frontend/src/components/Slider.tsx (pointerEvents="none" on the track/thumb).

Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/Slider.tsx thumb style uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset — on web these should be migrated to boxShadow (keep shadow* for native in Platform.select if needed).

action_items: Validate slider drag smoothness on a real Android device / Expo Go (web preview cannot exercise RN PanResponder properly through Playwright mouse events). On device, drag from near-left to ~75% and confirm value increases progressively (not jumping to max).
Migrate deprecated `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents` in editor.tsx and Slider.tsx to silence the deprecation warning.
Migrate deprecated `shadow*` styles to `boxShadow` for web (or wrap with Platform.select) in Slider.tsx thumb style.
critical_code_review_comments: Slider.tsx: PanResponder uses `locationX` which is reliable on native (touch) but relies on target-relative coordinates on web. The implementation (throttled emit, drag state, quantize) is correct for native; just note web-preview limitations.
_layout.tsx: Confirmed that `expo-navigation-bar` is no longer imported or used. Root background and StatusBar handling look correct. Font loading and hydrate() happen before render — good.
editor.tsx: Clean split layout. The empty state when !styleId correctly routes to the library — matches the requested test precondition.

PartEditorSheet.tsx: Sticky footer with Apply button is properly separated from the scrolling body; header row has chips + expand toggle with no overlap with the header save/undo/redo buttons (header is in editor.tsx, panel in PartEditorSheet.tsx; they live in different flex regions).

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4 of 5 priorities verified on web; priority 4 slider smoothness requires device verification)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The reported crash on Huawei Nova 9 SE (expo-navigation-bar undefined function) is a native-only Expo Go issue and cannot be reproduced on web. Web verification confirmed no red screen on load and that expo-navigation-bar is no longer referenced in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx. The 2D SVG fallback (testID avatar-2d-fallback) appearing after a few seconds on web preview is EXPECTED behavior and not a bug. Slider drag smoothness MUST be verified on a real device or Expo Go — Playwright mouse-event simulation does not drive React Native Web's PanResponder correctly for continuous drag.
rca_of_issue: Reported bug (Android Expo Go): NavigationBar.setButtonStyleAsync is undefined because expo-navigation-bar's native module is not shipped in Expo Go. Fix (already applied by main agent): removed all expo-navigation-bar imports/usages from app/_layout.tsx and rely on dark root background + StatusBar for the system-UI appearance. Verification on web: app loads with no 'undefined is not a function' / red-screen, navigation and editor flows all work.
